_comment: The E5 rig (rig-e5-turing.json) with the RTX 2080 SUPER reached through llama.cpp's RPC server on the same PC, as measured for phase 2a (benchmarks/phase2a-rpc-loopback.md): `gpuensemble worker --device CUDA1` serves the SUPER on 127.0.0.1:50052 and llama-server uses it as RPC0. Host and card numbers are the E5 rig file's; the RPC cost is the measured 0.8 ms per token (the default for a loopback address).
